_why: The instruments added on 2026-10-24 (owner: more companies, forex, metals). EVERY ONE WAS MEASURED FIRST through the exact Yahoo request the worker makes (scratchpad/yahoo-candidates.js): a real price, 1,500+ hourly candles, 2,500+ daily candles and under 3% FLAT bars at both - the ratio _flatRatio refuses to chart. What is NOT here was refused by that measurement or by a rule, and the reasons are below, because a list of what we left out is worth more than the list we kept.

_refused.VWAGY, MBGYY: pink-sheet OTC: 17-22% of their hourly candles are flat, which is the illiquid-feed signature _flatRatio exists to reject
_refused.XPT, XPD: platinum and palladium futures are clean hourly but 67% and 77% of their DAILY candles are flat - a 1D chart of either would be refused by _flatRatio and fall through to nothing
_refused.FRA40, EU50, HK50, AUS200, ESP35, SWI20,: cash indices, and our schedule calls index hours 24/5 on the New York clock while the cash market is open only locally - measured 2026-10-23 21:42 UTC, ^GDAXI's last bar was 15:30 UTC and ^N225's 06:30 UTC. A price frozen for 6-15 hours while we say the market is open is the one-sided bet the close path already refuses weekends for. GER40, UK100 and JPN225 have this hole TODAY - it is in the backlog, and nothing new joins them until it is closed.
_refused.USDTRY, USDZAR: a currency in structural decline is a one-way trade on a paper board - the lesson is not worth teaching
_refused.EA: Yahoo serves it fine from a laptop and our worker gets 91 hourly candles and ONE daily - caught only by verifying through our own endpoints after the deploy, which is why that step exists
